name: Bright Data
summary: The web data platform trusted by enterprises. Collect public web data at scale with proxies, ready-made datasets and scraping APIs — fuel for your market research and AI projects.
best_for: data teams and enterprises with real, ongoing web-data needs (pricing intelligence, market research) that justify committed volume and pass use-case vetting
skip_if: you need occasional small scrapes (Browse.ai-class tools or datasets are far cheaper), or your use-case wouldn't survive a compliance review
honest_knock: This is enterprise-grade web data infrastructure at enterprise-grade prices — the per-GB meter looks small until you multiply by real scraping volume, and the committed tiers only pay off if your usage is steady. The bigger honest note is compliance: Bright Data is strict about KYC and use-cases (a feature, not a bug), and whatever you collect still has to respect the target sites' terms and applicable law. Budget legal thought alongside the gigabytes.

pricing.notes: Usage-based (re-verified 2026-10-02): residential proxies start at $4.00/GB with no commitment, against a struck-through $8 — the $2.50/GB rate the overview page leads with is the $1,999/month tier, not the entry price. The committed residential tiers read $3.50/GB at $499/month (141 GB included), $3.00/GB at $999 (332 GB) and $2.50/GB at $1,999 (798 GB). Per-IP products are laddered the same way, and the headline rates are volume floors rather than starting points: datacenter runs $1.40/IP at 10 IPs, $1.00 at 100, $0.95 at 500 and $0.90 at 1,000, while ISP runs $1.80, $1.45, $1.40 and $1.30 across the same steps — so the real minimum is $14/month for ten datacenter IPs, not the $0.90 on the nav. API side: Unlocker, Crawl and SERP APIs from $1/1k requests (free tiers available), Scraper APIs $1.50/1k records pay-as-you-go with a 5K/month free tier and a $499 Scale plan bundling 384,000 records at $1.30/1k overage, Data Firehose $0.20/1k, Datasets from $250/100k records; managed offerings from $1,500/mo (Managed Data Acquisition) and Retail Insights from $2,000/mo.
